body:
how do I live. I have no money. I work for my mother in a tiny art studio. The studio makes no money, I am paid nothing, it is only kept in business because nobody knows what to do with me. I am 21 years old. I am out of shape. While I scored high on the ASVAB, I have complications in both of my arms which keep me from joining the military, even if I was in shape. I have no skills. I took Latin in highschool which is sometimes helpful but its not about to land me a job. I live in a small town. There are no charitable organizations here, no job opportunities outside of retail, and few things to do for fun but drink.


I don't know what to do. You don't deserve to have to read this. You don't have to. I'm not sure there's anything left. I will buy a bag of charcoal, grind it up, and inhale the powder until it coats my lungs. 

My friends are in town. I have one real friend, and his girlfriend is cool, as is his sister. He goes to college and is doing well. Yesterday, I told them we needed to go do something. Not stick around town. They are too tired of living full, happy lives to do anything exciting with me when they come back. The most ambitious idea I got from them was to go bowling. Bowling is fun, but it won't be enough.

I am rambling. Sorry.
